title: Many primes with power-smooth predecessors
exact_target: For each fixed delta in (0,1/4), does the number of primes p in (2x,5x] whose predecessor p-1 has no prime factor exceeding $x^\delta $ grow at least as $x^(1-o(1))$ as x tends to infinity? The error exponent may depend on delta.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

manuscripts.title: Weighted dilation graphs, smooth shifted primes and totient fibers
